submittedPrompt:
Edit Image 1, the existing eight-frame walking sheet. Repair only weapon and trouser continuity using Image 2, the original raider appearance reference. Keep all eight existing leg poses, arm motion, SW lower-left facing, body locations, chronological order, scale and camera. Preserve the gradual leg opening through frames 2, 3 and 4 and closing through frames 6 and 7.

Image 2 supplies appearance and equipment ONLY; do not copy its standing pose. Give every frame the same short wooden-handled, warm bronze axe held by the same anatomical right hand as Image 2 (the axe hand is on screen-left in that idle). The grip must stay attached to the handle as that arm swings; the other hand stays free. Carry the axe low beside the body, with consistent head size and shape. Restore Image 2's charcoal trouser fabric and torn knee openings, while keeping Image 1's leg silhouettes and joint positions.

Keep the pale bone mask, tied dark hair, charcoal shoulder wraps, ochre sash, leather bracers, brown boots, grounded adult proportions and deliberate crisp pixel clusters. Return the same four-column by two-row sheet with complete silhouettes and weapon clearance in every cell. Use actual transparent alpha, with no checkerboard, labels or grid.
